validation.environment: Existing local PostgreSQL; real headless Chromium and built Blazor application; controlled model/media providers, signed local OneBot/NapCat substitute and tool transports.
environmentVariables: PATH and DOTNET_ROOT select the user .NET 10 SDK
AIJADE_ARTIFACTS points to native macOS storage
AIJADE_TEST_DATABASE_URL points to the local development test database

browserDiagnostics.observed: 503 and net::ERR_FAILED responses during intentional unavailable/offline scenarios

productPromptPolicy.researchEvaluationOfNewProductPolicy: NOT_RUN; source integrity is not prompt or scientific equivalence

toolWorker.ambiguousOutcomes: Timeout, HTTP 408/5xx, network interruption or unreadable receipt; no further tools that turn and no automatic replay
doesNotGuarantee: real-model compliance with the error explanation

diagrams.visualQa: PNG views inspected for Chinese glyphs, node and edge readability, optional integrations, library/process distinction and research separation.
diagrams.tooling: Mermaid CLI 12.2.0 installed in a user-local skill environment with no browser download; existing Playwright Chromium reused.
diagrams.initialRenderAdjustment: CLI 12 removed -w; checked installed --help and switched to --size before successful rendering.

limits: Third-party plugins were read but not installed or executed; README experience claims remain unverified.
Live QQ accounts, licensed MMD assets, local trained voices/singing, actual device tools and real-model behavior require their own acceptance checks.
No autonomous social-platform login/posting, diary worker, dynamic code installation or automatic persona rewriting was introduced.
The in-memory queue is process-local; persistent deployments continue to require the existing Redis option.
Research baselines and original results were not rewritten. Product prompt policy changes require new configuration identity in future research.
